$comment: Homepage marketing sections for the slide-design-system. Pushed alongside storyblok-schema.json by scripts/push-storyblok-schema.mjs. These are nestable page sections meant to be dropped into the `page` component's `sections` field (not into a slideshow). Each section is tagged with `component_group: "Homepage"` (a name, not a uuid); the push script ensures that component group exists in the space and resolves it to the real uuid before pushing, so this file stays portable across spaces. Kept intentionally lean — one section renders one clear idea. Icons are Material Design Icon names (e.g. `mdi-pencil`); browse them at https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/.

icon.description: Material Design Icon name, e.g. `mdi-pencil`, `mdi-view-grid`, `mdi-lightning-bolt`. Browse: https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/. Leave blank for the default square mark.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the title, e.g. 'CLOUDFLARE · STORYBLOK · NUXT'.

columns.description: Number of columns on wide screens.

subtitle.description: Sub-line under the title, e.g. 'Select a deck to preview or present'.

slideshows.description: Reference the slideshow stories to feature. The order here is the order they appear. Leave empty to show every slideshow automatically.

description.description: Sub-line, e.g. 'Built with Nuxt 4, Storyblok, Vuetify and Cloudflare Pages — open source and free to fork.'
